rationales: Hacking is unauthorized access to computer systems, not a demand for payment to release a prize.
Advance fee fraud asks a victim to pay upfront to receive a promised prize or benefit.
Identity theft is the misuse of someone else's personal information.
Piracy is the illegal copying or distribution of protected material.
.htm is a valid file extension for a saved webpage.
.xhtml is not the expected standard extension among these choices for a webpage.
.doc is a word-processing document extension.
.xlsx is a spreadsheet file extension.
<dl> creates a description list, not a numbered list.
<ol> creates an ordered, numbered list.
<ul> creates an unordered, bulleted list.
<table> creates a table rather than a numbered list.
A diamond represents a decision or condition in a flowchart.
Input is usually shown with a parallelogram, not a diamond.
Output is usually shown with a parallelogram, not a diamond.
Progress is not the standard meaning of the diamond symbol.
Piracy means making or distributing illegal copies of protected material.
A right is a legal entitlement, not illegal copying.
Browsing means viewing or navigating websites.
Privacy concerns keeping personal information or activities protected.
Binary has base 2, not base 16.
Decimal has base 10, not base 16.
Octal has base 8, not base 16.
Hexadecimal has base 16.
A hard disk is not primary memory, which is directly used by the processor.
A hard disk is secondary memory used for long-term storage.
RAM is volatile primary memory, not a hard disk.
ROM is read-only primary memory, not a hard disk.
The negation of “Today is holiday” is “Today is not holiday.”
“Today is Sunday” does not negate the original proposition.
This repeats the original proposition instead of negating it.
“Today is not Sunday” does not negate the original proposition.
Test data is used to check a solution, not to define an algorithm.
An algorithm is a set of steps for solving a problem.
A process is a broad term and is not the precise definition asked for.
A prototype is an early model, not an algorithm.
The textbook classification gives five types of test data.
Twelve is not the number of test-data types in this classification.
Seven is not the number of test-data types in this classification.
Six is not the number of test-data types in this classification.
1024 GB is not equal to one megabyte.
1024 MB is approximately one gigabyte, not one megabyte.
One megabyte is equal to 1024 kilobytes in the conventional binary unit system.
1024 TB is far larger than one megabyte.
The statement combines two propositions, so it is not a single proposition.
“Multi” is not the standard classification for this proposition.
The conjunction “and” joins two propositions, making it compound.
“Value” does not describe the logical structure of the statement.
B1 represents 10110001 in binary, not 11000001.
1100 0001 groups into hexadecimal C1.
D1 represents 11010001 in binary, not 11000001.
E1 represents 11100001 in binary, not 11000001.
Two is not the number of layers in the TCP/IP model taught in this context.
Three is not the standard four-layer TCP/IP model.
The TCP/IP model is commonly described as having four layers.
Five is not the standard four-layer TCP/IP model.
Softlifting is unauthorized installation or use of software beyond its license, not specifically downloading it.
Counterfeiting is making or selling fake copies of software.
Hard disk loading is pre-installing unauthorized software on computers for sale.
Online piracy includes downloading illegal software from the internet.
